dashboard:defaultTo.label: Default to
dashboard:defaultTo.description: Null-coalesce. Returns `dflt` when `x` is null; `x` otherwise. Local utility for the dashboard helpers' row.data null-default and per-field defaults. Not surfaced as a std primitive — only the dashboard module uses it today.

dashboard:flattenProfile.label: Flatten profile
dashboard:flattenProfile.description: entity_instances row of entityType 'profile' → legacy profile wire-shape. Defaults data.type to 'person'; every other absent field projects to null via record-literal evaluation. Byte-equivalent to the TS dashboard.ts:flattenProfile helper.

dashboard:flattenInstance.label: Flatten entity instance
dashboard:flattenInstance.description: Generic entity_instances row → flattened wire shape (id + accountId + spread of data + createdAt + updatedAt). Used by every list/detail route over a non-profile entity (proxy_link, integration, page, …). Byte-equivalent to dashboard.ts:flattenInstance.

dashboard:flattenRelation.label: Flatten profile relation
dashboard:flattenRelation.description: entity_instances relation row → flattened wire shape WITHOUT updatedAt (handles / phones / tags / intents / purchases inside /profiles/:id). Sibling of flattenInstance; kept separate because the relation routes' wire-shape contract omits updatedAt and adding it would be a contract change (out-of-scope for 12a-1).

dashboard:readMetadata.label: Read subscription metadata
dashboard:readMetadata.description: Parse the subscription row's nullable metadata string to a Record. Wraps codec:jsonDecode + codec:unwrapJsonValue with the TS try/catch semantics: parse failures and non-object JSON values both collapse to {}. Byte-equivalent to dashboard.ts:readMetadata.

dashboard:parseMetadataString.label: Parse metadata string
dashboard:parseMetadataString.description: Private helper dispatched by readMetadata. Pattern-matches codec:jsonDecode's Result; on Ok JsonObject, calls codec:unwrapJsonValue to lower back to a plain Fenel record. Non-object JSON values (number / string / array / null) and Err results both collapse to {}. Split from readMetadata because the outer null-guard needs an ifElse + a multi-arm case can't compose inline with the ifElse arg position cleanly.

dashboard:flattenSubscriptionToTrigger.label: Flatten subscription → trigger
dashboard:flattenSubscriptionToTrigger.description: Subscription row → legacy trigger wire-shape. Reads metadata via dashboard:readMetadata; surfaces trigger / cancelWhen / args from the parsed metadata (null when absent); maps row.handlerFunctionId to functionId and row.enabled to active. Byte-equivalent to dashboard.ts:flattenSubscriptionToTrigger.

dashboard:maskCredentials.label: Mask credentials
dashboard:maskCredentials.description: Record<String, unknown> → Record<String, 'configured'>. Each entry whose value is non-null AND not the empty string becomes 'configured'; null and empty-string entries are dropped. Fenel-bodied via std:entries + std:fold + std:mapSet (Phase 3t.2 — the std record-iteration primitives exist, so the Fenel-first rule retired the TS native).

dashboard:patchProfile.label: Patch profile
dashboard:patchProfile.description: PUT /profiles/:id route body. Thin shim around state:updateInstance — the IO handler does the existing-row merge with Nothing-as-clear semantics, so the legacy route-level field-by-field merge loop is redundant. The TS wrapper still does the Zod validation + the field whitelist (handles/phones/tags arrays the schema accepts but the legacy route filtered out).

dashboard:deleteProfile.label: Delete profile
dashboard:deleteProfile.description: DELETE /profiles/:id route body. Calls state:deleteInstance which is idempotent on the wire. The TS wrapper retains the entityType-guard pre-check; without it a misrouted call could remove an unrelated row of any type.

dashboard:listPurchases.label: List purchases
dashboard:listPurchases.description: GET /purchases route body. Reads via state:listInstancesByName 'purchase' (envelope-merged rows post-12a-2 evolution) and maps each through flattenRelation (id + accountId + spread of data + createdAt — no updatedAt to match the legacy purchases wire shape).

dashboard:listItemsRaw.label: List items (raw envelope rows)
dashboard:listItemsRaw.description: GET /items route body. Returns raw envelope rows from state:listInstancesByName 'item'; the TS wrapper does the bespoke ItemRow flatten (slug/name/type hoisted to top level + remaining data nested under `config`). The bespoke shape can't be expressed in Fenel today — record-key iteration has no std primitive (no std:recordEntries); flagged for a future std-primitives sub-step.

dashboard:getItemRaw.label: Get item (raw envelope row)
dashboard:getItemRaw.description: GET /items/:id route body. Returns the raw Maybe<envelope row> from state:getInstance 'item' id; the TS wrapper does the ItemRow flatten + 404-on-Nothing framing.

dashboard:deleteItem.label: Delete item
dashboard:deleteItem.description: DELETE /items/:id route body. Calls state:deleteInstance — idempotent on missing rows. The TS wrapper drops the legacy entityType-guard (option b per the 12a-2 brief); documented contract erosion. UI only sends item-typed IDs to this endpoint.

dashboard:listPlansRaw.label: List plans (raw envelope rows)
dashboard:listPlansRaw.description: GET /plans route body. Returns raw envelope rows from state:listInstancesByName 'plan'; the TS wrapper does the PlanRow flatten (many specifically-named fields + a `config` nested-rest). Same recordEntries gap as items.

dashboard:getPlanRaw.label: Get plan (raw envelope row)
dashboard:getPlanRaw.description: GET /plans/:id route body. Returns the raw Maybe<envelope row> from state:getInstance 'plan' id; the TS wrapper does the PlanRow flatten + 404-on-Nothing framing.

dashboard:deletePlan.label: Delete plan
dashboard:deletePlan.description: DELETE /plans/:id route body. Same shape as deleteItem — thin state:deleteInstance call, entityType-guard dropped.

dashboard:listProxyLinks.label: List proxy links
dashboard:listProxyLinks.description: GET /proxy-links route body. Returns envelope-merged rows from state:listInstancesByName 'proxy_link' — the merged envelope IS the wire shape (id + accountId + spread of data + createdAt + updatedAt). Sort happens in the TS wrapper (no std:sortBy yet). Phase 12a sub-step 4 — removed the now-redundant `map flattenInstance rows` that had been silently dropping every data-side field on the wire (the same latent-bug shape as 12a-3's listPurchases fix).

dashboard:createProxyLink.label: Create proxy link
dashboard:createProxyLink.description: POST /proxy-links route body. state:tryCreateInstanceByName 'proxy_link' data — Result-shape return ({ok, value?, error?}) lets the TS wrapper map ok→201 / err→422. Zod validation stays in the TS wrapper (Decision D2 within 12a-2; full Zod retirement is 12b scope).

dashboard:updateProxyLink.label: Update proxy link
dashboard:updateProxyLink.description: PUT /proxy-links/:id route body. Thin state:updateInstance call — the IO handler's merge semantics replace the legacy route-level read+merge. The TS wrapper keeps the entityType pre-check + post-fetch+flatten of the updated row for the response wire shape.

dashboard:deleteProxyLink.label: Delete proxy link
dashboard:deleteProxyLink.description: DELETE /proxy-links/:id route body. Thin state:deleteInstance call; entityType-guard dropped.

dashboard:listEmailTemplates.label: List email templates
dashboard:listEmailTemplates.description: GET /email-templates route body. Returns envelope-merged rows from state:listInstancesByName 'email_template' (post-12a-2 envelope evolution). Phase 12a sub-step 4 — same latent-bug fix as listProxyLinks.

dashboard:createEmailTemplate.label: Create email template
dashboard:createEmailTemplate.description: POST /email-templates route body. state:tryCreateInstanceByName 'email_template' data — Result-shape return.

dashboard:updateEmailTemplate.label: Update email template
dashboard:updateEmailTemplate.description: PUT /email-templates/:id route body. Thin state:updateInstance call. Same wrapper pattern as updateProxyLink.

dashboard:deleteEmailTemplate.label: Delete email template
dashboard:deleteEmailTemplate.description: DELETE /email-templates/:id route body. Thin state:deleteInstance call; entityType-guard dropped.

dashboard:listEntityInstancesByType.label: List entity instances by type
dashboard:listEntityInstancesByType.description: GET /entity-instances/:entityType route body. Thin state:listInstancesByName call — returns the envelope-merged row shape (post-12a-2 IO handler evolution), which is a wire-shape NARROWING vs the legacy raw drizzle row (no `entityType` field). Documented as a surprise; downstream callers that read row.entityType need a follow-up.

dashboard:createEntityInstanceByType.label: Create entity instance (by type)
dashboard:createEntityInstanceByType.description: POST /entity-instances/:entityType route body. state:tryCreateInstanceByName entityType data — Result-shape return. The TS wrapper handles Zod validation + maps ok→201 / err→422.

dashboard:replaceEntityInstance.label: Replace entity instance
dashboard:replaceEntityInstance.description: PUT /entity-instances/:id route body. Thin state:updateInstance call. Despite the route name being 'replace', the IO handler merges with existing data (Nothing-as-clear semantics) — same as PATCH. The two routes (PUT + PATCH) collapse to the same body; both are kept as separate fnIds for matrix/observability granularity.

dashboard:patchEntityInstance.label: Patch entity instance
dashboard:patchEntityInstance.description: PATCH /entity-instances/:id route body. Thin state:updateInstance call. The legacy route did an explicit read+merge before calling updateEntityInstance; that's redundant with the IO handler's own merge — dropped in 12a-2 per the brief's pre-flight Decision E1.

dashboard:deleteEntityInstance.label: Delete entity instance
dashboard:deleteEntityInstance.description: DELETE /entity-instances/:id route body. Thin state:deleteInstance call. No type-guard by design — this is the generic surface where the caller has already chosen what to delete.

dashboard:flattenProfileFromMerged.label: Flatten profile (from merged envelope)
dashboard:flattenProfileFromMerged.description: Envelope-merged profile row → legacy profile wire-shape. Counterpart of flattenProfile (which reads `.data` from a raw drizzle row); this variant reads data fields directly from the top-level of the merged envelope produced by state:listInstancesByName (12a-2) + state:listInstances (12a-3). Same per-field defaults: type→'person'; every other absent field projects to null.

dashboard:outgoingRel.label: Outgoing relationship (no swap)
dashboard:outgoingRel.description: Outgoing branch of normaliseRelationship — mergeRecords rel { direction = 'outgoing', relatedProfile = null }. Extracted because parseApp doesn't continue an arg list across newlines; a multi-line if/ifElse with multi-line branches needs helper extraction to keep the conditional call single-line.

dashboard:incomingRel.label: Incoming relationship (with A/B swap)
dashboard:incomingRel.description: Incoming branch of normaliseRelationship — swaps profileAId/profileBId so the OTHER profile is consistently in profileBId and sets direction='incoming'. Sister of outgoingRel.

dashboard:normaliseRelationship.label: Normalise relationship direction
dashboard:normaliseRelationship.description: Given a profile_relationship envelope row + the selfId (profile whose detail page we're rendering), produce the normalised wire-shape where profileBId is ALWAYS the OTHER profile and `direction` records the original direction ('outgoing' when self was profileAId in storage; 'incoming' when self was profileBId). `relatedProfile` is left as null — resolved separately by attachRelatedProfile.

dashboard:attachRelatedProfile.label: Attach related profile
dashboard:attachRelatedProfile.description: Given a normalised relationship + the list of all profile rows, look up the row whose `id` matches rel.profileBId (post-normaliseRelationship, always the OTHER profile) and fold it in as `relatedProfile`. Unwraps the Maybe<row> from std:find to row-or-pass-through-on-Nothing so the wire shape matches the legacy `relatedMap[r.profileBId]` lookup.

dashboard:aggregateProfileRow.label: Aggregate profile row
dashboard:aggregateProfileRow.description: Per-profile stitch helper for the GET /profiles aggregation. Given the current-tag rows + handle rows + a profile envelope row, produces the flattened profile row annotated with `tags: [tag-name]` and `handleCount`. Extracted from listProfilesAggregated to keep the map callback as a single expression (parseLambda parses parseExpr, not parseBlock — multi-statement lambda bodies need a top-level fn extraction).

dashboard:listProfilesAggregated.label: List profiles (aggregated)
dashboard:listProfilesAggregated.description: GET /profiles route body. 3 parallel reads (profile rows + currentTags + handles) with per-profile stitching; output is the list of flattened profile rows each annotated with `tags: [tag-name]` (current tags only, validTo absent) and `handleCount`. Ordering + 100-limit kept in TS wrapper (no std:sortBy / std:take yet).

dashboard:getProfileDetail.label: Get profile detail
dashboard:getProfileDetail.description: GET /profiles/:id route body. The heaviest single body in the dashboard module: 8 reads (1 profile + 5 relations + 2 symmetric relationship sides + 1 purchases + 1 list-all-profiles for related-profile resolution) + relationship-direction normalisation + current-vs-past tag split. Returns Maybe<ProfileDetail-Core>: Nothing → 404; Just <core> → every key the legacy /profiles/:id response had EXCEPT activeFlows + entitlements (TS wrapper splices those — Decision I, deferred substrate-primitive question).

dashboard:createProfile.label: Create profile
dashboard:createProfile.description: POST /profiles route body. Thin wrapper around state:tryCreateInstanceByName 'profile' data — Result-shape return. The TS wrapper handles Zod validation, field whitelisting + defaults, the relation-iteration (handles/phones/tags arrays — Decision G keeps these in TS), and the response framing (fetch the new row + flatten for the 201 body).

dashboard:labelOrName.label: Label or name
dashboard:labelOrName.description: Read Labelable for a type/function name, projecting Maybe<LocaleString> to a plain String via locale:canonical. Falls through to the bare name when no Labelable instance is registered. Mirrors the legacy `lab ? canonical(lab) : r.name` ternary in dashboard.ts:enrichedDbRows.

dashboard:descriptionOrNull.label: Description or null
dashboard:descriptionOrNull.description: Read Describable for a type/function name, projecting Maybe<LocaleString> to a plain String or null when no Describable instance is registered. Mirrors the legacy `desc ? canonical(desc) : null` ternary.

dashboard:defaultViewOrNull.label: Default view or null
dashboard:defaultViewOrNull.description: Read the Viewable.defaultView typeclass method, projecting Maybe<String> to String-or-null. Mirrors `getDefaultView(id) ?? null`.

dashboard:defaultInlineViewOrNull.label: Default inline view or null
dashboard:defaultInlineViewOrNull.description: Read the Viewable.defaultInlineView typeclass method, projecting Maybe<String> to String-or-null. Mirrors `getDefaultInlineView(id) ?? null`.

dashboard:enrichTypeRow.label: Enrich type row with representations
dashboard:enrichTypeRow.description: DB type row → enriched legacy wire shape. Preserves every other field of the row via right-biased mergeRecords; the override record carries the typeclass-resolved label + description. The legacy types row dropped those columns post-Phase-6 — they now live in typeclass instances.

dashboard:synthesizeSystemTypeRow.label: Synthesize system-entity type row
dashboard:synthesizeSystemTypeRow.description: Convert a system entity ({id, type?, module}) to the legacy /types wire shape with the `system:` id prefix + Labelable / Describable / Viewable defaults. Used by listTypesMerged + getTypeDetail.

dashboard:synthesizeModuleTypeRow.label: Synthesize module-entity type row
dashboard:synthesizeModuleTypeRow.description: Convert a module entity ({id, type, module}) to the /types wire shape. The `id` is the module-qualified `<module>.<id>` name (e.g. engine.CompileSource) — the canonical identity that the /types detail links + getCatalogEntry qualified index address. The label is the bare `e.id`; description / defaultTemplate / defaultTemplateInline are null.

dashboard:synthesizeModuleFunctionRow.label: Synthesize module-function row
dashboard:synthesizeModuleFunctionRow.description: Convert a module FenelFunction record to the legacy /functions wire shape with the `module:` id prefix. The entire FenelFunction record is nested under `function` (mirrors the DB row shape).

dashboard:nameMatchesAny.label: Name matches any row
dashboard:nameMatchesAny.description: Predicate. True when `name` appears as the `name` field of any row. Used by the merge filters to suppress synth rows for entities already represented by DB rows.

dashboard:idMatchesAny.label: Id matches any row
dashboard:idMatchesAny.description: Predicate. True when `id` appears as the `id` field of any row. Used to filter out module entities already represented by a system entity.

dashboard:fnIdInDbRows.label: Function id appears in DB rows
dashboard:fnIdInDbRows.description: Predicate over function rows (DB shape). True when `id` matches any row.function.id (the legacy `dbIds.has(f.id)` check).

dashboard:keepSystemNotInDb.label: Keep system entity not in DB
dashboard:keepSystemNotInDb.description: Filter predicate for the system-entities pass. True when the system entity's id is NOT already a DB row name.

dashboard:keepModuleNotInDbOrSys.label: Keep module entity not in DB or system
dashboard:keepModuleNotInDbOrSys.description: Filter predicate for the module-entities pass. True when the module entity's id is neither in DB rows nor in systemEntities. Chained if/else if avoids the parseApp / infix ambiguity for multi-line predicates.

dashboard:keepFnNotInDb.label: Keep module function not in DB
dashboard:keepFnNotInDb.description: Filter predicate for the module-functions pass. True when the function's id is NOT represented by any DB row's `function.id`.

dashboard:listTypesMerged.label: List types (merged DB + system + module)
dashboard:listTypesMerged.description: GET /types route body. Reads 3 sources (DB type rows + system entities + module entities), enriches DB rows with typeclass-resolved label/description, synthesizes system + module rows for entries not already covered by DB rows. Returns one merged list in legacy order (DB → system → module).

dashboard:getTypeDetail.label: Get type detail (merged)
dashboard:getTypeDetail.description: GET /types/:name route body. Three-stage fallback: DB row → enrich; else module-entity → synthesize; else Nothing (TS wrapper maps to 404). System entities are NOT looked up by name here — the legacy /types/:name only checks DB + module-entity (system entities only surface via /types/seed or /types list). Preserves legacy semantics.

dashboard:listFunctionsMerged.label: List functions (merged DB + module)
dashboard:listFunctionsMerged.description: GET /functions route body. Reads DB function rows + module functions; synthesizes module-function rows for fns not already represented as a DB row. Returns one merged list.

dashboard:getFunctionDetail.label: Get function detail (merged)
dashboard:getFunctionDetail.description: GET /functions/:name route body. Two-stage fallback: DB row → return; else module function → synthesize → return; else Nothing.

dashboard:defaultToIo.label: Default to (io)
dashboard:defaultToIo.description: Local null-coalesce for the io module's helpers. Same shape as dashboard:defaultTo (helpers.fenel) but local to io.fenel — kept separate because each .fenel file's defs are co-located with their callers; sharing would tie the load order of the two modules.

dashboard:hasBody.label: Function has body
dashboard:hasBody.description: Predicate: true when a FenelFunction record has a Fenel-language body (fn.body !== undefined). Drives the durable-vs-oneshot decision for /io/invoke — bodied functions dispatch through the durable runtime; bodyless functions go through the IOInvokable.ioAction handler.

dashboard:shouldDurable.label: Should use durable path
dashboard:shouldDurable.description: Combined gate: mode is 'run' AND fn has body. mode 'stop' always goes one-shot (the durable runtime has no 'stop a waiting instance' primitive; the IOInvokable's stopAction handler owns teardown).

dashboard:durableDecision.label: Durable invocation decision
dashboard:durableDecision.description: Second-stage check for the DurableStart arm. The durable runtime needs the DB row UUID (functions.id), not the fnId slug. Returns DurableStart dbFn.id when the function is seeded; NotSeededInDb fnId otherwise.

dashboard:runDecision.label: One-shot run decision
dashboard:runDecision.description: One-shot run path. Returns OneShotRun <action> when ioRunAction(fnId) is Just; NoActionConfigured fnId 'run' otherwise.

dashboard:stopDecision.label: One-shot stop decision
dashboard:stopDecision.description: One-shot stop path. Returns OneShotStop <action> when ioStopAction(fnId) is Just; NoActionConfigured fnId 'stop' otherwise.

dashboard:oneShotDecision.label: One-shot decision (run or stop)
dashboard:oneShotDecision.description: Fanout for non-durable cases. Dispatches to runDecision for mode 'run' and stopDecision for mode 'stop'. The legacy /io/invoke had a ternary at the action-resolution line; this preserves the same fork structure.

dashboard:decideInvoke.label: Decide /io/invoke dispatch arm
dashboard:decideInvoke.description: POST /io/invoke decision body. Pattern-matches on dispatch:getModuleFunction (NotFoundFn on miss); otherwise routes through shouldDurable to either durableDecision (DurableStart / NotSeededInDb) or oneShotDecision (OneShotRun / OneShotStop / NoActionConfigured). The TS wrapper switches on InvokeDecision.$tag and runs the matching IO arm. The decision is read-only; the wrapper holds params (built from fn.params + args) in scope.

dashboard:listIoInstancesBase.label: List IO instances (base)
dashboard:listIoInstancesBase.description: POST /io/instances substrate-read body. Returns {runs: List Row, listAction: Maybe String}. The TS wrapper does the per-row lastResult truncation + timestamp slicing (Decision U — record-key iteration has no std primitive) AND the runtime-determined invokeIOAction dispatch for the deployments list (no Fenel-side dynamic-dispatch primitive today).

dashboard:projectAwaitingRow.label: Project awaiting row
dashboard:projectAwaitingRow.description: Per-row projection for /io/awaiting. Reads variables._suspendMeta.schema for AwaitingChoice rows (a JSONB sub-record with prompt / source / schema). functionName is JOINed at the substrate layer (state:listFunctionInstances does a leftJoin); falls back to functionId on null.

dashboard:listAwaiting.label: List awaiting instances
dashboard:listAwaiting.description: GET /io/awaiting body. Filters function_instances by the 3 suspension statuses (awaiting_choice / waiting_event / waiting_timer); projects each row to the legacy wire shape via projectAwaitingRow.

dashboard:projectCompletedInstance.label: Project completed instance
dashboard:projectCompletedInstance.description: Completed-arm projection (value = variables._lastResult). Extracted from projectResumedInstance because parseApp doesn't continue arg accumulation across newlines — a multi-line ifElse with multi-line record branches needs helper extraction.

dashboard:projectSuspendedInstance.label: Project suspended instance
dashboard:projectSuspendedInstance.description: Suspended-arm projection (status = inst.status). Sister of projectCompletedInstance.

dashboard:projectResumedInstance.label: Project resumed instance
dashboard:projectResumedInstance.description: Post-resume row → wire shape. Single-line ifElse dispatching to projectCompletedInstance or projectSuspendedInstance based on inst.status.

dashboard:resolveAwaitingErr.label: Resolve awaiting error envelope
dashboard:resolveAwaitingErr.description: Error envelope used by both 'instance not found' and resume-throw cases. The TS wrapper discriminates 404 vs 500 by the error message string.

dashboard:resolveAwaitingResumed.label: Resolve awaiting (resumed projection)
dashboard:resolveAwaitingResumed.description: Second-stage of resolveAwaiting: project the post-resume row via projectResumedInstance, or surface the resume error.

dashboard:resolveAwaiting.label: Resolve awaiting instance
dashboard:resolveAwaiting.description: POST /io/awaiting/:id/resolve body. Three stages: (1) existence + accountId-scoped lookup; (2) resume + re-read; (3) project the post-resume row OR surface the error. Returns {ok, value?, suspended?, status?, error?}; the TS wrapper maps to 404 / 500 / 200 response codes.

dashboard:projectLastResult.label: Project last-result instance
dashboard:projectLastResult.description: Last-completed function_instance row → /io/last-result wire shape. Emits {id, value, startedAt, completedAt}.

dashboard:lastResult.label: Last result for a function
dashboard:lastResult.description: GET /io/last-result body. Two-stage Maybe lookup: DB function row by name, then last-completed instance by DB UUID. Returns Maybe<{id, value, startedAt, completedAt}>; the TS wrapper maps Nothing → {ok: true, instance: null}.

dashboard:listSpecInstancesAll.label: List typeclass instances (account)
dashboard:listSpecInstancesAll.description: GET /typeclass-instances?class=… body. Thin pass-through to state:listSpecInstances; the TS wrapper extracts the ?class query param and frames {typeclassInstances}.

dashboard:getSpecInstanceById.label: Get typeclass instance by id
dashboard:getSpecInstanceById.description: GET /typeclass-instances/:id body. Thin pass-through to state:getSpecInstance; the TS wrapper maps Nothing → 404 and frames {definition}.

dashboard:createAccountSpecInstance.label: Create account typeclass instance
dashboard:createAccountSpecInstance.description: POST /typeclass-instances body. Persists the row + composes dispatch:refreshAccountInstances so the in-memory typeclass registry reflects the new state on the next dispatch. Returns the created row.

dashboard:updateAccountSpecInstance.label: Update account typeclass instance
dashboard:updateAccountSpecInstance.description: PUT /typeclass-instances/:id body. Updates the row's instance + refreshes dispatch. Returns the updated row.

dashboard:deleteAccountSpecInstance.label: Delete account typeclass instance
dashboard:deleteAccountSpecInstance.description: DELETE /typeclass-instances/:id body. Deletes the row + refreshes dispatch. Returns Unit; the TS wrapper frames {ok: true}.

dashboard:listFunctionTriggers.label: List function triggers
dashboard:listFunctionTriggers.description: GET /functions/:name/triggers body. Function lookup → subscription list; returns Maybe<List Row>. The TS wrapper does the sort + map(flatten) (no std:sortBy primitive yet) and maps Nothing → 404.

dashboard:createFunctionTrigger.label: Create function trigger
dashboard:createFunctionTrigger.description: POST /functions/:name/triggers body. Function lookup + create subscription + flatten. Returns Maybe<Trigger>; Nothing → 404. The TS wrapper does the Zod validation + the crypto.randomUUID slug generation and passes them in as params.

dashboard:applyMetaTrigger.label: Apply trigger metadata field
dashboard:applyMetaTrigger.description: Per-field Maybe-aware metadata merge helper. Just v → overwrite meta.trigger with v; Nothing → preserve. Extracted because parseApp doesn't continue arg lists across newlines, so multi-arm case-of forms need their own helper.

dashboard:applyMetaCancelWhen.label: Apply cancelWhen metadata field
dashboard:applyMetaCancelWhen.description: Sister of applyMetaTrigger for the cancelWhen field.

dashboard:applyMetaArgs.label: Apply args metadata field
dashboard:applyMetaArgs.description: Sister of applyMetaTrigger for the args field.

dashboard:mergeTriggerMetadata.label: Merge trigger metadata
dashboard:mergeTriggerMetadata.description: Fold three Maybe<Record> fields into the existing metadata record. Each Just overwrites the matching key; each Nothing preserves it. Used by PUT /triggers/:id to compose the merged metadata before passing to state:updateSubscription.

dashboard:defaultToLocal.label: Default to (local)
dashboard:defaultToLocal.description: Local null-coalesce for the typeclass-triggers-timeline helpers. Same shape as dashboard:defaultTo (helpers.fenel) and dashboard:defaultToIo (io.fenel) — kept local since each .fenel file's defs are co-located with their callers.

dashboard:newTriggerEventType.label: New trigger event type
dashboard:newTriggerEventType.description: PUT /triggers/:id eventType selector. When the body's trigger record has a non-null `.type`, use it; else preserve the column's existing value. Mirrors the legacy `body.trigger?.type ? body.trigger.type : existing.eventType`.

dashboard:updateTriggerById.label: Update trigger by id
dashboard:updateTriggerById.description: PUT /triggers/:id body. Existing lookup + metadata merge + update + flatten. Returns Maybe<Trigger>; Nothing → 404 (row doesn't exist OR belongs to a different account OR was deleted between read and update).

dashboard:deleteTriggerById.label: Delete trigger by id
dashboard:deleteTriggerById.description: DELETE /triggers/:id body. Returns Boolean — true on hit, false on miss / cross-account. The TS wrapper maps false → 404 and true → {ok: true}.

dashboard:projectTimelineInstance.label: Project timeline instance
dashboard:projectTimelineInstance.description: Drizzle function_instance row → the timeline route's `instance` wire shape (drops accountId; keeps everything else).

dashboard:projectTimelineEvent.label: Project timeline event
dashboard:projectTimelineEvent.description: events row → wire shape ({id, type, aggregateType, aggregateId, payload, createdAt}).

dashboard:maybeCompletedAt.label: Maybe completed-at
dashboard:maybeCompletedAt.description: Wrap inst.completedAt in a Maybe so the substrate primitive's open-ended-time-range Maybe parameter receives the right shape. Nothing → events SQL has no upper bound; Just ts → SQL `<=` ts.

dashboard:eventsForInstance.label: Events for instance
dashboard:eventsForInstance.description: Gated on profileId — instances without a profileId return []. Otherwise reads profile-scoped events bounded by [startedAt, completedAt?] via state:listEventsByAggregate.

dashboard:functionInstanceTimeline.label: Function instance timeline
dashboard:functionInstanceTimeline.description: GET /functions/:fnId/instances/:instId/timeline body. Instance lookup → if found, fan out traces + events reads + project the 3-part wire shape `{instance, traces, events}`. Returns Maybe<TimelineResponse>; Nothing → 404.

dashboard:sqvDefaultToLocal.label: Default to (local)
dashboard:sqvDefaultToLocal.description: Null-coalesce — local to the saved-queries-and-views module.

dashboard:queryIdsForCategory.label: Query ids for category
dashboard:queryIdsForCategory.description: Given a member list, project the queryIds for one categoryId.

dashboard:memberMatchesCategory.label: Member matches category
dashboard:memberMatchesCategory.description: Predicate for filtering members by categoryId.

dashboard:extractQueryId.label: Extract query id
dashboard:extractQueryId.description: Projection helper — member row → its queryId.

dashboard:stitchCategoryRow.label: Stitch category row
dashboard:stitchCategoryRow.description: Attach queryIds[] inline to a single category row. Pure record merge over the all-members list.

dashboard:stitchCategoryMembers.label: Stitch category members
dashboard:stitchCategoryMembers.description: Given all categories + all members, return the stitched list with queryIds[] inline on each (Decision II pattern).

dashboard:pickSavedQueries.label: Pick saved queries branch
dashboard:pickSavedQueries.description: Case-of dispatch over (category, q) Maybes — Just category → savedQueriesByCategory; Just q → savedQueriesBySearch; else default.

dashboard:listSavedQueriesAggregated.label: List saved queries aggregated
dashboard:listSavedQueriesAggregated.description: GET /saved-queries — branch dispatch + always returns {queries, categories} with each category carrying queryIds[].

dashboard:shouldActivateNew.label: Should activate new
dashboard:shouldActivateNew.description: First-row-is-active gate. body.active=true OR no existing rows. Uses ifElse (or is infix-only — 12a-6 surprise #1).

dashboard:clearOthersIfActive.label: Clear others if active
dashboard:clearOthersIfActive.description: Gated side-effect — clear all active locus_views iff willBeActive=true.

dashboard:createLocusViewBody.label: Create locus view body
dashboard:createLocusViewBody.description: POST /locus-views — create + single-active invariant composition (Decision FF).

dashboard:promoteIfWasActive.label: Promote if was active
dashboard:promoteIfWasActive.description: Gated promote — if the deleted row was active, promote oldest remaining; else no-op.

dashboard:createQueryCategoryBody.label: Create query category body
dashboard:createQueryCategoryBody.description: POST /query-categories — create + optional bulk-members insert + return cat with queryIds[] inline.

dashboard:insertMembersIfAny.label: Insert members if any
dashboard:insertMembersIfAny.description: Gated bulk insert — empty list = no-op.

dashboard:addQueryToCategoryBody.label: Add query to category body
dashboard:addQueryToCategoryBody.description: POST /query-categories/:id/queries — 2 lookups (cat + query) + insert; returns {ok, error}.

dashboard:getQueryCategoryById.label: Get query category by id
dashboard:getQueryCategoryById.description: Lookup helper — wraps listQueryCategories + filter (no dedicated state primitive; rarely-used direct lookup).

dashboard:extractTotal.label: Extract total
dashboard:extractTotal.description: Project the `total` field off a row. Used by sumRowTotals.

dashboard:sumRowTotals.label: Sum row totals
dashboard:sumRowTotals.description: Sum the `total` field across a row list.

dashboard:statusEquals.label: Status equals
dashboard:statusEquals.description: Partial-applied predicate over rows by their `status` field. `statusEquals s` returns row→Bool; consumed by std:find.

dashboard:lookupStatusTotal.label: Lookup status total
dashboard:lookupStatusTotal.description: Find the row matching `status`; return its total, or 0 on miss.

dashboard:flowWaitingCount.label: Flow waiting count
dashboard:flowWaitingCount.description: Sum of (waiting_event + waiting_timer + awaiting_choice) counts. The 3 status flavours all count as 'waiting' for /stats.flows.waiting.

dashboard:projectPurchaseSummary.label: Project purchase summary
dashboard:projectPurchaseSummary.description: Project a single purchases-by-status-with-revenue row to the wire shape {status, count, revenueCents}.

dashboard:dashboardStats.label: Dashboard stats
dashboard:dashboardStats.description: GET /stats — 4 substrate reads + per-row projections. Wire shape: {profiles, purchases, flows}.

dashboard:analyticsTimeseriesBody.label: Analytics timeseries body
dashboard:analyticsTimeseriesBody.description: GET /analytics/timeseries — single substrate call + thin frame. Wire shape: {timeseries, days, since}.

dashboard:analyticsSummary.label: Analytics summary
dashboard:analyticsSummary.description: GET /analytics/summary — 4 substrate reads + assembly. Wire shape: {revenue, profiles, events, purchases}.

dashboard:ioActionName.label: Normalize IO action name
dashboard:ioActionName.description: Normalize an IOInvokable action field to one Maybe String. Raw strings and Just strings become Just; Nothing, missing fields and non-string values become Nothing.

dashboard:ioRunAction.label: Read IO run action
dashboard:ioRunAction.description: Resolve the IOInvokable instance in the caller's scope through dispatch.lookupOne and normalize its ioAction field to Maybe String. Missing instances and missing action fields return Nothing.

dashboard:ioStopAction.label: Read IO stop action
dashboard:ioStopAction.description: Resolve the IOInvokable instance in the caller's scope through dispatch.lookupOne and normalize its stopAction field to Maybe String. Missing instances and missing action fields return Nothing.

dashboard:ioListInstancesAction.label: Read IO instance-list action
dashboard:ioListInstancesAction.description: Resolve the IOInvokable instance in the caller's scope through dispatch.lookupOne and normalize its listInstancesAction field to Maybe String. Missing instances and missing action fields return Nothing.

dashboard:getLocusRootBody.label: Get root data
dashboard:getLocusRootBody.description: Read the account's one Fenel root value through its storage effect.

dashboard:editLocusRootBody.label: Edit root data
dashboard:editLocusRootBody.description: Apply a root edit to the revision the user actually edited.
